intended_claim: The registered R08-B fixed joint-edit neighbourhood provides sufficient opportunity to enter R08-C.
what_results_support: All 48 fixed unique-parent tasks completed; 48 anchors plus 671 paid edits equal 719 completed requests, with 97 missing menu slots retained rather than backfilled.
At least one >=1% H-J edit exists for 19/48 tasks, including 11/32 full and 8/16 local tasks; 74 edits meet the material threshold.
The finite registered menu contains some useful configurations, but its parent-equal oracle mean is only 0.011954778056381211 and its material net-joint share is 11/74 = 0.14864864864864866.

Saved-source implementation, menu structure, CSV arithmetic and five exact archived request samples are consistent with the declared raw-anchor, 8-pass lower solver, original-H and proxy-validation accounting.
The B-based D engineering projection includes menu construction and equals 12660.580331580939 s, below 21600 s; this is not measured training throughput.
what_results_dont_support: Sufficient joint opportunity to enter C: oracle mean >=1.5% and material net-joint share >=50% both fail.
Learned policy improvement, four-step learnability, causal joint interaction benefit, or advantage over same-budget RuleMenu, Single-RL, Fixed3 or Detour.
Attributing all raw cleanup, 2-opt, final-set or H-induced changes to the explicit joint action.
Real robot IK, swept-arm collision or physical joint trajectory certification; saved validation explicitly excludes those.
Actual multi-step DRL throughput, future-stage success, new-parent generalization or final-test performance.
missing_evidence: The original two failed opportunity thresholds are unmet; no replacement experiment is authorized or requested.
No C/D/E measurements exist and none should be fabricated; any revised neighbourhood or thresholds require a separate proposed protocol and authorization.
A full paper claim audit was outside this bounded review; downstream paper-writing claims remain provisional without it.
routing_action: STOP_R08_B_FIXED_NEIGHBOURHOOD; preserve negative result; C_D_E_NOT_RUN_NOT_AUTHORIZED; no automatic new experiment or larger menu.

independent_checks.source_review_scope: PROTOCOL, menu.py, lower.py, science.py, ANALYSIS_SOURCE_BINDING, RESULTS, three result CSV files, RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING, supervisor receipt, all saved menu/task JSON, five exact gzip members, four original R08-A normative documents. No old60/oldS3/confirmation/final task read.

limitations: This is a saved-output and source review, not a fresh execution of the original validator or exhaustive archived-member audit. The all-valid aggregate is supported by original code and sampled certificates, not independently regenerated physical constraints.
Observed setup 22.641020055605622 s is accepted as the recorded setup component; the throughput formula and all CSV-derived timing components were independently recalculated.
